title: SE implementation scratchpad - Sunrise Credit
content:
Context / goal:
- Quick personal scratchpad for Sunrise Credit Dedicated/Private deployment onboarding. Captures action items, config notes, and open questions.
- Primary ask: low-latency chat + structured responses for customer support workflows; strict data residency in eu-west-1; KMS-managed keys; SLA for p95 latency < 220ms for small (<256 token) responses.

Meeting notes (2024-11-14 kickoff):
- Attendees: Samira (SE), Ethan (Infra), Priya (Customer AM), Sunrise SRE + Security (Luca, Maria)
- Decided: start with Dedicated reserved capacity in eu-west-1; private control plane (VPC connect) for audit/logging; canary rollout to 10% traffic after initial validation.
- Next steps: infra to share VPC/subnet ranges and VPN details; security to share KMS template and compliance checklist.

High-level implementation checklist (owner -> status rough):
- Network setup (Ethan) -> TODO: request Sunrise VPC CIDR + peering details (open)
  - Need: list of allowed IP ranges, NAT/GW expectation, route tables
  - Firewall: open outbound 443 to Redwood endpoints; inbound only from Redwood bastion for admin.
- Private control plane config (Samira) -> IN PROGRESS
  - Control plane in customer account? They prefer customer-managed control plane in their AWS account. Need account ID and role ARNs.
- KMS & encryption (Priya + Sunrise Sec) -> TODO: customer to create CMK with key policy that trusts Redwood role; get key ARN
- S3 endpoints & logging (Ethan) -> TODO: provide S3 bucket name for model artifacts + CloudTrail logging destination
- Certs & domain (Sunrise) -> TODO: confirm TLS cert owner (they want to use their CA via ACM).
- Model selection & runtime config (Samira) -> RECOMMENDATION below
- Canary & rollout plan (Samira) -> DRAFT below
- Evals / acceptance tests (Priya + Sunrise QA) -> prepare 200 prompt set + expected answer goldens; run baseline with hosted public model first.
- Compliance artifacts (Security) -> request ISO/PCI checklist items from Sunrise; map to Redwood controls.

Model/runtime config notes (initial):
- Customer profile: interactive support (mostly short context < 512 tokens), occasional long-form summarization (up to ~2048). Expected peak QPS ~30, average 12.
- Recommendation: rwd-medium-13b-quant (quantized 4-bit) as primary for cost/latency tradeoff. Have a higher-quality rwd-large-34b as fallback for escalation flows.
- Latency targets: aim for p95 < 220ms for primary model on Dedicated nodes sized for concurrency 32.
- Batch settings: dynamic batching enabled, max batch size 16 for interactive; prefer continuous batching with per-request priority to reduce tail latency.
- KV/prefix cache: enable prefix caching for repeating prompts (support templates for support replies). TTL 24h initially.
- Max tokens: request limit 2048; set streaming enabled for chat flows.

Serving & infra specifics:
- Dedicated pool: 4 x A100 equivalent (config TBA) in eu-west-1 for initial pilot (expected headroom for QPS 30).
- Autoscaling policy: maintain 60% GPU util target; allow burst to on-demand up to +50% for short windows.
- Routing: prefer eu-west-1; fallback to eu-central if capacity constrained and customer allows (tbd).
- Logging: request log retention 90d for traces; export usage metrics to customer CloudWatch (or S3) per legal.

Rollout plan (draft):
- Stage 0: infra & KMS setup (week 1)
- Stage 1: internal smoke tests with synthetic prompts (week 2)
- Stage 2: invite-only canary (5-10% traffic, 48-72h) monitor latency, error rate, output quality (week 3)
- Stage 3: expand to 25% if metrics stable (another 48h)
- Stage 4: full traffic + run evaluation suite + finalize runbooks (week 4)
- Rollback: automatic fallback to hosted smaller model + alerting if p95>400ms or error rate >1% sustained for 10m.

Acceptance criteria / QA metrics:
- Latency: p95 <220ms for short requests; p99 <500ms
- Availability: <1% error rate during canary window
- Quality: pass 85% of golden prompts in eval set (subjective review pass by Sunrise ops)

Open questions / risks:
- Data residency: they require all inference to occur in eu-west-1 with logs stored in eu-region. Confirm whether any control-plane metadata touches Redwood-hosted control plane in US.
- KMS access: customer wants strict split of duties; need to confirm if customer-managed CMK with external key policies acceptable.
- Network topology: will Sunrise provide AWS account for Redwood deployment or prefer cross-account roles?
- Fallback model: confirm acceptable fallback model (exact variant) if Dedicated pool saturated.
- Throughput spikes: need SRE input on expected burst patterns (day/time) to size autoscaling and reserved capacity.

Immediate TODOs (actionable items):
- [ ] Samira: draft IAM role and trust policy template for customer review (due 2024-11-18)
- [ ] Ethan: gather required VPC/subnet details and share network diagram (due 2024-11-19)
- [ ] Priya: schedule security review call with Sunrise Sec (Luca) and attach compliance checklist (due 2024-11-17)
- [ ] Sunrise SRE: provide CMK ARN + bucket for model artifacts (due 2024-11-19)
- [ ] Samira: prepare initial canary eval set (200 prompts) and baseline outputs from hosted model (due 2024-11-20)

Notes-to-self / small reminders:
- Keep communication channel: create #sunrise-ses Slack channel and invite Ethan, Priya, Sunrise SREs.
- Add a short runbook for emergency fallback (how-to disable dedicated pool and route to hosted) - important for Friday demo.
- Check GH PR se-configs/pull/45 for the latest terraform network module; may need to tweak for Sunrise CIDR patterns.
- Follow up: call with Sunrise security on Wednesday 11/20 09:30 CET.

Quick config snippets (notes):
- example IAM trust: arn:aws:iam::SUNRISE_ACCOUNT_ID:role/RedwoodDeployRole
- KMS policy: customer CMK with Allow Encrypt/Decrypt for Redwood service principal + restrict via aws:SourceAccount and aws:SourceVpc conditions
- model config (pseudoyaml):
  - model: rwd-medium-13b-quant
    max_tokens: 2048
    streaming: true
    batch_size: dynamic
    kv_cache_ttl: 86400

Last checkpoints / status as of 2024-11-21:
- IAM template initial draft complete (Samira)
- Network info still pending from Sunrise (pinged Priya for follow-up)
- Security call scheduled for 11/20; expect CMK ARN after that call

End of scratchpad - keep updating as we get tickets/answers.
_note: This file is a personal working doc; contains informal notes and action items. Save final artifacts to Confluence / JIRA when stabilized.
